locked_runtime_contract_policy.observation: One exact AnalyzedWaveSubject, one approved finite transport price retained without coercion, and one exact non-blank opaque provenance reference.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.pair: Two exact observation objects whose subject references are the same live object, retained in exact proposed_start and proposed_end roles.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.role_meaning: Caller-designated Runtime operands only; no validated endpoint, chronology, direction, pivot, extreme, orthodox end, or completion.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.arithmetic: None; price values are transport only.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.immutability: Frozen and slotted at ordinary API level; validate-before-assignment single-use constructors and ordinary subclass sealing prevent rebinding and reordering.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.copy: copy and deepcopy preserve the same immutable live identity.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.replacement: Dataclass replacement creates a distinct revalidated untrusted object.
locked_runtime_contract_policy.serialization: Default pickle is rejected; JSON-compatible records and explicit reconstruction are audit-only untrusted data.
